components.cost_effect: O(d) arithmetic per step and O(d) sum storage; no additional Oracle queries.
components.goal: Form the specified average without storing the trajectory.
components.key_estimate: Exact identity q/t=(1/t) sum_(i=0)^(t-1)x_i; asymptotic performance is supplied only by the linked Theorem.
components.name: trajectory_average
components.operation: Add pre-update x_(t-1) to q and output q/t.
transfer_checks: Match average indexing, linear drift, gain and every conditional noise assumption before using the CLT.

limitations.statement: Constant gains and nonlinear drift are outside this selected variant.

performance_links.scope_note: Only the exact linked power-law linear CLT regime; no finite-time or optimality assertion.

variants.cost: T residual Oracle calls over T steps; O(d) extra vector arithmetic per step and O(d) iterate/sum state, excluding Oracle implementation/storage. Averaging adds zero Oracle calls. Internal cost of forming A x-b is separately excluded from this Oracle-call count.
variants.name: Power-law decreasing gain
variants.output: bar x_T=q/T=(1/T) sum_(i=0)^(T-1)x_i. In particular bar x_1=x_0.
public_inputs: Dimension d; deterministic x_0; residual Oracle; c>0; a in (0,1); chosen iteration count T. The update needs no inverse of A.
variants.query_and_update: For t>=1 first set q <- q+x_(t-1). Query y_t at x_(t-1), then set x_t=x_(t-1)-c t^(-a)y_t. Report q/t as the average.
variants.requirements: Oracle returns y_t=A x_(t-1)-b+xi_t. Execution requires these observations. The CLT additionally requires every model and conditional noise assumption of the linked Theorem.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set x=x_0 in R^d, running sum q=0 in R^d, and integer t=1.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Choose fixed c>0, 0<a<1 and T>=1. Source supplies no accuracy-based or data-dependent stopping rule.

use_restrictions: Resource accounting describes the explicit implementation and excludes internal residual Oracle cost.
Performance is conditional on the linked Theorem; this is not an unrestricted Oracle Complexity claim.
Staging proposal only; independent Reviewer and publication have not occurred.

links.note: Exact assumptions, output and asymptotic regime are in the linked statement.

source_refs.source_version: SIAM J. Control Optim. 30(4):838–855, July 1992; university-hosted journal scan

summary: Executable linear SA with a power-law gain and pre-update arithmetic-average output.
title: Averaged linear SA with slowly decreasing gain
use_when: Implement the selected recursion and use the linked CLT only after checking its complete assumptions.
